feature: Cooperative Picco book startup with loading screen and cancellation
host_checks: Failed file replacement preserves the pending fallback
Cancellation returns fonts and unchanged saved state
A cancelled job can be retried with the same owned inputs
Loading frames render in portrait/landscape and two/four display levels
Existing restored-position and synchronous-pixel-equivalence tests pass
compiled_device_behavior: Wake resume is attempted before default EPUB and TXT candidates
Hash/index steps are separated by input and Wi-Fi polling
Button or tap cancellation falls back to the library or specimen without journal writes during loading
Loading progress refreshes at most once every two seconds
Initial loading frame uses the orientation input barrier
limitations: Host tests do not execute the ESP-IDF event loop
Metadata/chapter parsing, font/state loading, and library scanning remain synchronous
Physical cancellation latency, wake-button behavior, display timing, and peak memory remain unqualified
